sentences.text: Chaka Khan -LRB- born Yvette Marie Stevens , March 23 , 1953 -RRB- is an American recording artist whose career has spanned five decades , beginning in the 1970s as the frontwoman and focal point of the funk band Rufus .	funk	funk	Rufus	Rufus (band)	frontwoman	Frontman
Widely known as the Queen of Funk , Khan has won ten Grammys and has sold an estimated 70 million records worldwide .	Queen of Funk	Honorific nicknames in popular music
Khan was ranked at number 17 in VH1 's original list of the 100 Greatest Women of Rock & Roll .

In 2015 , she was nominated for induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame for the second time ; she was previously nominated as member of Rufus in 2011 .	Rufus	Rufus (band)	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

Khan was the first R&B artist to have a crossover hit featuring a rapper , with `` I Feel for You '' in 1984 .	R&B	Rhythm and blues	crossover	crossover (music)	rapper	rapper	I Feel for You	I Feel for You (album)

In the course of her solo career , Khan has achieved three gold singles , three gold albums and one platinum album with I Feel for You .	I Feel for You	I Feel for You (album)	gold	gold record	platinum album	platinum record
With Rufus , she achieved four gold singles , four gold albums , and two platinum albums .	Rufus	Rufus (band)	gold	gold record
In December 2016 , Billboard magazine ranked her as the 65th most successful dance artist of all time .	Billboard magazine	Billboard (magazine)
